parameters.jsCode: const x=$json.body??$json; const due=String(x.due_date??''); const today=String(x.as_of_date??new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)); const amount=Number(x.balance_due); const validDate=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(due)&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(today); const days=validDate?Math.floor((Date.parse(today+'T00:00:00Z')-Date.parse(due+'T00:00:00Z'))/86400000):null; let action='manual_data_review'; if(String(x.status??'').toLowerCase()==='paid'||amount===0)action='close_as_paid'; else if(validDate&&Number.isFinite(amount)&&amount>0)action=days>30?'escalation_review':days>0?'payment_reminder_draft':days===0?'due_today_notice_draft':'no_reminder'; return [{json:{invoice_reference:String(x.invoice_reference??''),balance_due:Number.isFinite(amount)?amount:null,due_date:due,days_overdue:days,recommended_action:action,send_automatically:false,human_review_required:true,note:'Check disputes, credits and payment allocations before contacting a customer.'}}];
